# Meagan Swenson

> Full-stack developer with 25+ years of experience building websites and web applications, from the user interface to the database. Based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Main stack: Oracle/PL-SQL, PHP/Laravel, React and HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with AI-assisted and agentic development in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

Experience includes Hewlett-Packard/EDS (2002–2018), Philips (2019–2023), Albert Heijn / Ahold Delhaize (2023–present) and independent contract work (2026–present). Open to new opportunities.
